title: SOL wallet shadow-replay pilot
objective: Build the Solana-only offline adapter and pilot on authorized historical local inputs: normalize/deduplicate events, price and liquidity as-of lookup, fee model, chain-specific unfillable rules, golden fixtures, negative cases, and deterministic replay evidence. This Solana adapter must not be blocked by BSC stage activation.
forbidden_actions: Do not execute real trades, sign transactions, broadcast transactions, or connect a trading wallet.
Do not read seed phrases, private keys, browser cookies, login sessions, DPAPI material, or trading API keys.
Do not automate a logged-in GMGN page; only consume user-provided offline exports from the private root.
Do not commit wallet addresses, transaction hashes, raw GMGN exports, chainfm_out contents, or private manifests containing raw records.
Do not treat null, unknown, or missing values as zero.
Do not create a cross-chain global wallet score or assume SOL and BSC addresses identify the same entity.
Do not squash, rebase, rewrite pushed history, push to main, or merge a PR.
Do not start live monitoring, infer a trade from token-account transfer alone, or use price data before simulated_order_at.
acceptance_commands: MUST IMPLEMENT AND EXECUTE before DONE: tsx src/cli/run-sol-wallet-shadow-replay-pilot.ts --private-root "$CHAINFM_OUT_DIR" --input-manifest "$CHAINFM_OUT_DIR/sol/sol_shadow_replay_input_manifest.json" --output-private "$CHAINFM_OUT_DIR/sol/sol_shadow_replay_pilot_v0_1/"; use authorized real private input, run twice with identical input, verify input/output record counts and identical output SHA-256, write replay_manifest.json and source_hashes.json, and verify chainfm_out is not tracked by Git.
